title: A Voice in the Wilderness
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: John the Baptist lived in the wild, empty land by the Jordan River. He wore rough camel’s hair and a leather belt. He ate wild honey and big grasshoppers called locusts.
Heavenly Father gave John a job: get people ready for Jesus. John called out, “Repent!” To repent is to turn from wrong and come back to Heavenly Father.
Long before, the prophet Isaiah said a voice would call, “Make the way ready!” Isaiah was talking about John.
p2: Back then, people fixed bumpy roads before a king came. John helped people smooth the bumpy places in their hearts for Jesus.
People came from all around. They said sorry, and John baptized them in the river. Tonight, you can get your heart ready for Jesus too.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
